We will check with your Insurance Company if your cost is covered. | How long does it take to replace my Windshield? | Windshield replacement typically takes between 30 minutes to 2 hours, depending on the complexity of the job. | Is it safe to drive with a cracked Windshield? | It's not recommended to drive with a cracked windshield as it can compromise the structural integrity of the vehicle and increase the risk of further damage or injury in an accident. | How much does it cost to replace a windshield? | The cost of windshield replacement varies depending on the make and model of your vehicle, the type of glass used, and the location where the replacement is done. The comprehensive coverage in your insurance policy will cover the cost of the replacement. | Can a chipped or cracked windshield be repaired instead of replaced? | It depends on the size, location, and severity of the damage. Small chips and cracks can often be repaired, but larger or more severe damage usually requires a windshield replacement. | What should I do if my windshield is damaged by a rock or other object? | If your windshield is damaged by a rock or other object, it's important to have it inspected by a professional as soon as possible. Ignoring the damage can lead to more significant problems down the road. | How do I choose a reliable auto glass repair shop? | Look for a shop that is experienced, uses high-quality materials, and has a good reputation in the industry. It's also a good idea to ask for references or read reviews from previous customers. | Can I get a ticket for driving with a damaged windshield? | Yes, it's possible to receive a ticket for driving with a damaged windshield, as it can be considered a safety hazard. | What kind of warranty is included with a windshield replacement? | Rocket Auto Glass will warrant the replacement for the life of your vehicle ownership. We cover labor and materials. Once the vehicle is transferred or sold to another party, the warranty expires. | Can a windshield be replaced in cold weather? | Yes, a windshield can be replaced in cold weather, but it's important to make sure that the adhesive used to install the new windshield is suitable for low temperatures. | Can I wash my car after getting a new windshield installed? | Yes, but waiting at least 48 hours before washing your car is essential to allow the adhesive to cure fully. Going through a car wash within 48 hours would void the warranty of the installed item. After 48 hours, it would be fine to do so. | How do I know if my windshield needs to be replaced or repaired? | If the damage is smaller than a dollar bill, it may be repairable, but if the damage is larger, it's likely that the windshield will need to be replaced. | How long do I have to wait to drive my car after installing a new windshield? | You should wait at least one hour before driving your car after a new windshield installation to allow the adhesive to start bonding. | How can I prevent my windshield from getting damaged? | Avoiding following too closely behind other vehicles, especially Dump Trucks carrying debris and gravel substances. Staying away from gravel roads, and parking in a garage or covered area can help prevent damage to your windshield. It is also not recommended to park under trees. | Can I drive my car with a taped windshield? | No, it's not safe to drive with a taped windshield as the tape will not provide enough support and may come off while driving. | Can I use my car heater or defroster it after getting a new windshield installed? | Yes, but it's recommended to wait at least 48 hours before using your car heater or defroster to allow the adhesive to cure fully. | Will my windshield look the same after it has been replaced? | Yes, a professional installation should leave your new windshield looking just like the original. | Can I get a windshield replacement if my car has an Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS)? | Yes, but it's vital to choose a repair shop that is experienced in handling ADAS systems and can recalibrate them after the windshield replacement. At Rocket Auto Glass, we have teamed up with Calibration Specialists to take care of the Recalibration of the system. | Can I file a claim with my insurance company for a second windshield replacement? | It depends on your insurance policy and the specific circumstances. You should contact your insurance provider to determine if a second windshield replacement will be covered. We will check with your Insurance Company if your cost is covered. | How long does it take to replace my Windshield? | Windshield replacement typically takes between 30 minutes to 2 hours, depending on the complexity of the job. | Is it safe to drive with a cracked Windshield? | It's not recommended to drive with a cracked windshield as it can compromise the structural integrity of the vehicle and increase the risk of further damage or injury in an accident. | How much does it cost to replace a windshield? | The cost of windshield replacement varies depending on the make and model of your vehicle, the type of glass used, and the location where the replacement is done. The comprehensive coverage in your insurance policy will cover the cost of the replacement. | Can a chipped or cracked windshield be repaired instead of replaced? | It depends on the size, location, and severity of the damage. Small chips and cracks can often be repaired, but larger or more severe damage usually requires a windshield replacement. | What should I do if my windshield is damaged by a rock or other object? | If your windshield is damaged by a rock or other object, it's important to have it inspected by a professional as soon as possible. Ignoring the damage can lead to more significant problems down the road. | How do I choose a reliable auto glass repair shop? | Look for a shop that is experienced, uses high-quality materials, and has a good reputation in the industry. It's also a good idea to ask for references or read reviews from previous customers. | Can I get a ticket for driving with a damaged windshield? | Yes, it's possible to receive a ticket for driving with a damaged windshield, as it can be considered a safety hazard. | What kind of warranty is included with a windshield replacement? | Rocket Auto Glass will warrant the replacement for the life of your vehicle ownership. We cover labor and materials. Once the vehicle is transferred or sold to another party, the warranty expires. | Can a windshield be replaced in cold weather? | Yes, a windshield can be replaced in cold weather, but it's important to make sure that the adhesive used to install the new windshield is suitable for low temperatures. | Can I wash my car after getting a new windshield installed? | Yes, but waiting at least 48 hours before washing your car is essential to allow the adhesive to cure fully. Going through a car wash within 48 hours would void the warranty of the installed item. After 48 hours, it would be fine to do so. | How do I know if my windshield needs to be replaced or repaired? | If the damage is smaller than a dollar bill, it may be repairable, but if the damage is larger, it's likely that the windshield will need to be replaced. | How long do I have to wait to drive my car after installing a new windshield? | You should wait at least one hour before driving your car after a new windshield installation to allow the adhesive to start bonding. | How can I prevent my windshield from getting damaged? | Avoiding following too closely behind other vehicles, especially Dump Trucks carrying debris and gravel substances. Staying away from gravel roads, and parking in a garage or covered area can help prevent damage to your windshield. It is also not recommended to park under trees. | Can I drive my car with a taped windshield? | No, it's not safe to drive with a taped windshield as the tape will not provide enough support and may come off while driving. | Can I use my car heater or defroster it after getting a new windshield installed? | Yes, but it's recommended to wait at least 48 hours before using your car heater or defroster to allow the adhesive to cure fully. | Will my windshield look the same after it has been replaced? | Yes, a professional installation should leave your new windshield looking just like the original. | Can I get a windshield replacement if my car has an Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS)? | Yes, but it's vital to choose a repair shop that is experienced in handling ADAS systems and can recalibrate them after the windshield replacement. At Rocket Auto Glass, we have teamed up with Calibration Specialists to take care of the Recalibration of the system. | Can I file a claim with my insurance company for a second windshield replacement? | It depends on your insurance policy and the specific circumstances. You should contact your insurance provider to determine if a second windshield replacement will be covered.
